title: 第1章 傻子上坟第2章 获得医圣传承
content_zh:
;;
“叔，你太会了！”
九月半，天刚蒙蒙亮，露水挂在枝头。
桃花村西僻静的玉米地里就已传出辛勤老农起早施肥的声音。
早起的虫儿有鸟吃。
这是在村里见多识广老人的金玉良言。
玉米地旁一条稍微有些泥泞的小路上。
身材高大的傻子李向东肩上扛着尼龙袋，里面装着给去世爷爷过阴寿的纸钱线香馒头贡品。
正慢悠悠的往这边走来。
傻子不是一直傻。
十八岁之前，他还是村里有史以来最会读书的天才。
高考考了六百八十多分，以市状元的成绩上了北青大学。
可惜后来在学校里因为一个女生争风吃醋，被情敌打坏脑子和下体。
自此记忆全失，智商退化到四岁左右，被迫休学回家养伤。
让本就不富裕的家庭雪上加霜。
临近玉米地，李向东被一阵奇怪的声音吸引。
他以为是地里进了野物正在偷吃玉米，兴奋的放下尼龙袋。
小心翼翼拨开玉米杆子循着声音走进去，打算抓到手给久病在床的母亲补补身体。
不多时刻，他就寻到声音的源头，见到了让他这个智商所不能理解的一幕。
微醺晨光中。

村里恶霸二狗的俊俏媳妇王彩凤正在和村长，同时也是二狗堂叔的李宏财打架！
他们打得十分激烈。
有时王彩凤打赢。
不知道被汗水还是露水打湿的发丝紧紧贴着额头，一双妩媚杏眼半撑半闭。
有时她又被打输，被李宏财打得哭着喊着求饶
可惜李宏财这个长辈一点也不让着她，越打满是丘壑的脸上越容光焕发。
李向东傻的这两年，是非常惧怕李宏财和李二狗的。
在这个山高皇帝远的桃花村，乡里县里都有人的李宏财就是说一不二的土皇帝。
村霸李二狗就是他手下最厉害的打手，没人敢和他们叔侄俩对着弄。
作为村里唯二的傻子，李向东时常被他们忽悠戏弄，还带着尺寸惊人的软脚虾四处闲逛过。
惹得村里大闺女小媳妇脸红唾骂又爱又恨。
为此母亲刘月红千叮咛万嘱咐，碰到村长和二狗一定绕着走。
惹不起咱躲得起。
眼看俩人架打的越来越剧烈，王彩凤逐渐呼吸困难。
整个人像河里的虾一样弓着，看起来马上就会被打死！
李向东见状心惊胆战，趁着他们打的激烈没注意到他，悄悄原路退了回来。
捡起尼龙袋子扛上肩头，逃命一般飞快的离去。
桃花村后山半山腰阴面，是一片新开垦的坟地。
content_en:
;;
"Uncle, you are so good!"
It was mid-September, the sky was just dawning, and dew was hanging on the branches.
In the secluded cornfield in the west of Taohua Village, the sound of hardworking farmers getting up early to apply fertilizer can be heard.
The early bird catches the early bug.
This is a wise saying from a well-informed old man in the village.
A slightly muddy path next to a cornfield.
Li Xiangdong, a tall fool, carried a nylon bag on his shoulder, which contained paper money, thread and incense steamed buns as tribute to his deceased grandfather.
He is walking slowly this way.
A fool is not always stupid.
Before the age of eighteen, he was the best reading genius in the history of the village.
I scored more than 680 points in the college entrance examination and entered Beiqing University with the top score in the city.
Unfortunately, later on, because he was jealous of a girl in school, his love rival broke his brain and body.
Since then, he has lost all his memory and his IQ has dropped to about four years old. He was forced to drop out of school and go home to recuperate.
This makes families who are already not wealthy even worse.
Approaching the cornfield, Li Xiangdong was attracted by a strange sound.
He thought that wild animals had entered the field and were eating the corn, so he excitedly put down the nylon bag.
Carefully pushing aside the corn stalks, he followed the sound and walked in, intending to grab his hand to replenish the health of his mother who had been ill in bed for a long time.
In a short time, he found the source of the sound and saw a scene that his intelligence could not understand.
A little tipsy in the morning light.
Wang Caifeng, the handsome daughter-in-law of Ergou, the village bully, is fighting with Li Hongcai, the village chief and Ergou's cousin!
They fought fiercely.
Sometimes Wang Caifeng wins.
Her hair, wet with sweat or dew, was pressed tightly against her forehead, and her charming almond eyes were half-opened and half-closed.
Sometimes she was defeated again and was beaten by Li Hongcai until she cried and begged for mercy.
It's a pity that the elder Li Hongcai didn't give in to her at all. The more he beat her, the more radiant his face became.
Li Xiangdong has been stupidly afraid of Li Hongcai and Li Ergou for the past two years.
In this Taohua Village, where the mountains are high and the emperor is far away, Li Hongcai, who has people in every township and county, is the undisputed local emperor.
The village tyrant Li Ergou was his most powerful thug, and no one dared to fight against his uncle and nephew.
As the only fool in the village, Li Xiangdong was often fooled and teased by them, and he even brought a surprisingly large soft-footed shrimp around.
It made the eldest daughter-in-law and daughter-in-law in the village blush, curse, love and hate her.
For this reason, my mother, Liu Yuehong, warned me a lot that I must walk around the village chief and Ergou whenever I see them.
If we can't afford to offend, we can afford to hide.
Seeing that the fight between the two became more and more fierce, Wang Caifeng gradually had difficulty breathing.
The whole person was hunched over like a shrimp in the river, looking like he was about to be killed!
Li Xiangdong was frightened when he saw this. He took advantage of the fierce fight between them and didn't notice him, so he quietly retreated back the way he came.
He picked up the nylon bag, put it on his shoulder, and left quickly as if running for his life.
Halfway up the mountain behind Taohua Village, on the shady side, is a newly reclaimed cemetery.
